::: {#exm-log-softmax}

#### Log softmax of the logits

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
by_theorem = logits[0] - torch.logsumexp(logits[0], dim=0)
by_torch = torch.log_softmax(logits[0], dim=0)
log_softmax_gap = (by_theorem - by_torch).abs().max().item()
print(by_theorem.detach().numpy().round(3))
print(log_softmax_gap)
```

For the first test image,
the [logits](#def-logits) minus their [log-sum-exp](#def-log-sum-exp)
agree with PyTorch's `torch.log_softmax` to within `r format(py$log_softmax_gap, digits = 2)`.
Each is near $\log \frac{1}{10} \approx `r sprintf("%.2f", log(0.1))`$.

:::
